questions.title: Create a CustomResourceDefinition manifest file for an...
questions.body:
Create a CustomResourceDefinition manifest file for an Operator with the following specifications :
* *Name* : `operators.stable.example.com`
* *Group* : `stable.example.com`
* *Schema*: `<email: string><name: string><age: integer>`
* *Scope*: `Namespaced`
* *Names*: `<plural: operators><singular: operator><shortNames: op>`
* *Kind*: `Operator`

questions.title: Create the CRD resource in the K8S API
questions.body: Create the CRD resource in the K8S API

questions.title: Create custom object from the CRD
questions.body:
Create custom object from the CRD

* *Name* : `operator-sample`
* *Kind*: `Operator`
* Spec:
  * email: `operator-sample@stable.example.com`
  * name: `operator sample`
  * age: `30`

questions.title: Describe the CRD
questions.body: Describe the CustomResourceDefinition `operators.stable.example.com` and inspect its group, scope, versions and accepted names.

questions.title: Inspect a custom object as YAML
questions.body: Show the custom object `operator-sample` you created earlier as YAML, then use 'kubectl explain' to inspect the Operator spec fields.

questions.title: Create a cluster-scoped CRD
questions.body:
Create a CustomResourceDefinition manifest (save it as clusteroperator-crd.yaml and apply it) with:
* *Name*: `clusteroperators.stable.example.com`
* *Group*: `stable.example.com`
* *Version*: `v1` (served, storage)
* *Scope*: `Cluster`
* *Names*: plural `clusteroperators`, singular `clusteroperator`, kind `ClusterOperator`, shortNames `cop`
* *Schema*: spec with a string field `region`.

questions.title: Delete a custom object
questions.body: Delete the custom object `operator-sample` of kind `Operator`, then confirm it is gone with a listing command.
